channel.welcome:
Press [%1$s] to open the Channel config screen,
and adjust your microphone and audio processing options.
channel.config.title: Channel Config
channel.config.mic.samplerate.tooltip:
Default sample rate.
The highest sound frequency that can be captured is half of the sample rate.
§7If your microphone requires a specific sample rate,
you can change it in the config file.
AI Noise Cancellation only supports 16000Hz or 48000Hz.
channel.config.mic.samplebits.tooltip: The default sample bits cannot be changed.
channel.config.mic.listen.tooltip:
Playback the pre-processed sound.
Regardless of the trigger mode, the content is basically the same as what others hear.
channel.config.level.raw.tooltip: Output level directly from the selected device
channel.config.ai.down:
§6Nvidia AFX SDK on this computer is missing or incomplete.
 
§6Then switch the noise cancellation mode again.
channel.config.ai.down.tooltip:
§7If you confirm it is installed,
and the relevant dll and model files exist together,
you can specify the path of NVAudioEffects.dll in the config file.
channel.config.ai.down.here: §b§nManually download and install the Nvidia Audio Effects SDK here,
channel.config.ai.os:
§6Your current operating system does not support this feature.
§6Windows 10 or higher is required.
channel.config.ai.gpu:
§6Your current graphics card does not support this feature.
§6NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060,
§6Quadro RTX 3000, TITAN RTX or higher is required.
channel.config.ai.driver:
§6Your current graphics card driver version does not support this feature.
§6Version 570.x or higher is required.
channel.config.ai.sample_rate:
§6The current sample rate is not supported.
§6Please adjust the sample rate to 16000Hz or 48000Hz,
§6and then switch the noise cancellation mode again.
channel.config.ai.exception:
§6An exception occurred in the program.
§6Check the log for more information.
channel.config.pre.trigger.always.toolti: All captured sound will be sent to the server.
channel.config.pre.trigger.vad.tooltip:
§6Experimental Feature§r
Only sends to the server when voice is detected in the captured sound.
channel.config.pre.trigger.threshold.too: Only sound exceeding the specified loudness will be sent to the server.
channel.config.pre.trigger.ptt.tooltip:
The captured sound will only be sent to the server while the key is held down.
§6WIP
channel.config.pre.vad.tooltip:
Set the trigger threshold for voice activity detection.
A lower option makes it easier for the same audio segment to be considered as containing voice.
channel.config.pre.threshold.tooltip:
Set the trigger threshold for loudness detection.
The audio input from the device must be greater than this value to be considered valid.
channel.config.pre.nc.tooltip:
Set the noise cancellation strength.
A higher option filters background noise more strongly, but may affect human voice.
§2AI noise cancellation mode consumes some GPU resources.
channel.config.pre.nc.ai_intense.tooltip:
Set the AI noise cancellation strength.
A higher value filters background noise better.
channel.config.pre.hpf.tooltip: Eliminate low-frequency components in the sound.
channel.config.pre.ec.tooltip:
Eliminate echo collected by the microphone. May slightly increase latency.
§2In AI noise cancellation mode, this option only targets room reverberation, not speaker echo.
channel.config.pre.mgc.tooltip:
Manually increase the input loudness.
A larger value makes your voice louder to others.
§bThe automatic limiter is always applied.
channel.config.pre.agc.tooltip:
Automatically adjust the input loudness.
It may take a few seconds to adapt.
channel.config.pre.target.tooltip:
Set the target value for automatic gain.
A larger value makes your voice louder to others.
channel.config.pre.max_gain.tooltip:
Limit the upward adjustment capability of the automatic gain.
A larger value will amplify subtle sounds.
channel.config.net.length.tooltip:
Determines how often data is sent to the server.
A shorter frame helps reduce latency, while a longer frame helps reduce network usage.
channel.config.net.samplerate.tooltip:
Determines the quality of the transmitted sound.
The highest sound frequency that can be transmitted is half of the sample rate.
A lower sample rate helps reduce network usage,
while a higher sample rate helps improve audio quality.
channel.config.subspace.off: Subspace relay is not enabled on this server.
channel.config.post.rt.tooltip:
§6Experimental Feature§r
Use path tracing for a more realistic audio experience.
Will consume additional CPU resources.
channel.config.post.player_control.toolt:
Adjust the sound loudness of this person individually.
Will override the overall loudness.
A larger value makes the sound you hear louder.
§6Not controlled by the limiter.
channel.config.post.control_adjust.toolt:
Adjust the sound loudness of all outputs.
A larger value makes the sound you hear louder.
§6Not controlled by the limiter.
channel.config.post.player_control_clear: Reset all individual loudness adjustments below.
channel.config.unit.db: Decibel dB / Decibels relative to full scale dBFS
channel.config.post.delay.tooltip:
Copes with different network qualities by adjusting the buffer size.
A smaller value helps reduce audio latency.
A larger value helps cope with unstable network environments, reducing popping and stuttering.
channel.notify.failed_find:
Device %1$s not found.
The default input device is used.
channel.notify.unsupported: The selected parameters are not supported by this input device.
